The page is live at `http://localhost:8787/live.html` (server on port 8787). Here's what it does:

**Dashboard layout:**
- **Account bar** — your wallet `0xaD60…3834`, equity ($17.38), cash, unrealized and realized PnL
- **Three market cards** — NVDA, AAPL, GLD — each showing perp price (large), spot price, 24h change, volume, high/low, mark, oracle, funding rate, and open interest
- **Positions table** — currently empty (no open positions); will populate live if you open one
- **Connection status** in the header

**Live updates** — seeds from REST, then subscribes to `pod_markets` and `pod_positions` over WebSocket (`wss://staging-rpc.podtestnet.dev`). Prices update on every pod tick (~500ms). Reconnects automatically if the connection drops.

**NVDA 1% alert** — the NVDA card shows the reference price (set at page load) and current distance. When the perp price moves 1% from the reference:
- An amber banner appears at the top
- A two-tone beep plays
- A browser notification fires (if you granted permission)
- **Reset** resets the reference to the current price; **Dismiss** hides the banner permanently

The file is [live.html](file:///Users/sabpap/Workspace/Clients/Laurium/pod-ai-variants/1-raw/live.html) [📁](file:///Users/sabpap/Workspace/Clients/Laurium/pod-ai-variants/1-raw/).
